rebuttals.text: Wes Moore let people believe he earned medals he didn't.
Wes Moore is a motivational speaker playing governor.
Wes Moore is Oprah's candidate, not Maryland's.
Maryland's budget went from surplus to a multi-billion-dollar deficit under Wes Moore.
Wes Moore governs by announcement; the follow-through is thin.
Wes Moore has one term of governing against a lifetime of being introduced as the future.
